summary: The note is a brief entry about the film "A Sunday in Kigali". It reports its box office performance in Quebec in fall 2006 and its planned English-speaking Canadian release date. It also notes that video and cable are the main distribution options in other territories.
one_line: A Sunday in Kigali, a film that grossed $1.1 million CAD in Quebec in 2006 and was set for a September 23 English Canadian release.
key_facts: "A Sunday in Kigali" grossed $1.1 million Canadian in Quebec in the fall of 2006.
"A Sunday in Kigali" is set for a September 23 release in English-speaking Canada.
Video and cable are the best options for "A Sunday in Kigali" in other territories.
